title: How it works
intro: Four steps from application to bringing your puppy home.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Complete the puppy application below. It helps us understand your home and what you are looking for in a puppy.

steps.title: Talk
steps.text: We get in touch to talk through your application, answer your questions, and make sure a Cavalier is the right fit for your family.

steps.title: Reserve
steps.text: Once we agree it is a good match, a $1,000 non-refundable deposit reserves your puppy. It counts toward the price. You also sign our sales contract.

steps.title: Go home
steps.text: Pick up your puppy in Bonney Lake, meet us at Seattle–Tacoma Airport or in SeaTac, or arrange a drop-off. Your puppy goes home with a starter kit and vet records.
